mission.title: woodpecker-ci: Run  manual pipeline: allow executing a single/specific pipeline if more than one pipeline definitions exist
mission.description: Run  manual pipeline: allow executing a single/specific pipeline if more than one pipeline definitions exist. Requested by 6+ users.

steps.title: Check current woodpecker-ci deployment
steps.description:
Verify your woodpecker-ci version and configuration:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n woodpecker-ci -l app.kubernetes.io/name=woodpecker-ci
helm list -n woodpecker-ci 2>/dev/null || echo "Not installed via Helm"
```
This feature requires a working woodpecker-ci installation.

steps.title: Review woodpecker-ci configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant woodpecker-ci configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n woodpecker-ci -l app.kubernetes.io/name=woodpecker-ci
kubectl get configmap -n woodpecker-ci -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=woodpecker-ci
```
### Clear and concise description of the problem

The "Run pipeline" button in the UI, which is triggered for `"event: manual"`, currently executes all existing pipeline definitions under `.woodpecker/`.

steps.title: Apply the fix for Run  manual pipeline: allow executing a single/specific…
steps.description:
I see. That's one solution, however, the manual pipeline triggering is an ultimate fallback if anything goes wrong for whatever reason. Not having it is making this setup very uncomfortable. Let's say the requirement for database building changes, at one point in a way, that cannot be represented by cron. Let's say it should be a manual triggering based on some external event. And suddenly, you need to rework your pipelines. I think the individual manual triggering is the most basic requirement

See the source issue for community-verified solutions.

steps.title: Verify the feature works
steps.description:
Test that the new capability is working as expected:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n woodpecker-ci -l app.kubernetes.io/name=woodpecker-ci
kubectl get events -n woodpecker-ci --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm the feature described in "Run  manual pipeline: allow executing a single/specific…" is functioning correctly.
